skills.name: layercache-getting-started
skills.description: Install Layercache and configure a multi-layer cache stack (memory + Redis + disk) with stampede prevention.

skills.name: layercache-api-reference
skills.description: Complete API reference for CacheStack, MemoryLayer, RedisLayer, DiskLayer, tags, wrap(), namespace(), and bulk ops.

skills.name: layercache-invalidation
skills.description: Tag-based, prefix, wildcard, and generation-based invalidation across all layers, with Redis pub/sub fan-out.

skills.name: layercache-resilience
skills.description: Circuit breaker, stale-while-revalidate, stale-if-error, per-command timeouts, and graceful degradation.

skills.name: layercache-observability
skills.description: OpenTelemetry tracing, Prometheus metrics, event hooks, and HTTP stats endpoints.

skills.name: layercache-integrations
skills.description: Middleware for Express, Fastify, Hono, tRPC, GraphQL, and Next.js.
